summary: I'm a QA Automation Engineer with 6+ years of experience building quality into high-load web and mobile applications — with a strong focus on payment systems and FinTech products.At FAVBET, I built the company's first automation framework from scratch using TypeScript and Playwright, taking critical payment flow coverage from 0% to 85% and cutting regression testing time by 5 hours per release cycle.
